columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: The time the event was generated, taken from the source event timestamp.

columns.name: EventTime
columns.description: The original event timestamp as reported by Uniqkey.

columns.name: EventId
columns.description: Unique identifier of the event. Use for deduplication (delivery is at-least-once).

columns.name: Category
columns.description: Event category, e.g. authentication, credential_access, sharing, threat_detection.

columns.name: ActionId
columns.description: Stable identifier of the action type. Use this key in detection rules.

columns.name: ActionSource
columns.description: Source surface of the action, e.g. extension, mobile, web, desktop.

columns.name: Outcome
columns.description: Outcome of the action: success or failure.

columns.name: OrganizationId
columns.description: Identifier of the Uniqkey organization the event belongs to.

columns.name: ActorId
columns.description: Identifier of the actor that performed the action.

columns.name: ActorEmail
columns.description: Email address of the actor that performed the action.

columns.name: ActorType
columns.description: Type of actor: user, scim, system, supporter or breach.

columns.name: ClientSystem
columns.description: Client system used: extension, mobile, web, desktop or undefined.

columns.name: SrcIpAddr
columns.description: Source IP address of the client, when available.

columns.name: TargetType
columns.description: Type of the target object: vault, employee, group, employee_group, resource_collection or tag.

columns.name: TargetId
columns.description: Identifier of the target object, when available.

columns.name: TargetName
columns.description: Display name of the target object, when available.
